name: slow-query-index
description: Reviews a branch migration that adds a customer lookup index to a large orders table.

sql: CREATE TABLE forger_orders (id bigserial PRIMARY KEY, customer_id text NOT NULL, status text NOT NULL, total_cents integer NOT NULL, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now());

INSERT INTO forger_orders (customer_id, status, total_cents, created_at) SELECT 'c' || (g % 100)::text, CASE WHEN g % 7 = 0 THEN 'refunded' ELSE 'paid' END, 1000 + (g % 9000), now() - (g || ' seconds')::interval FROM generate_series(1, 100000) AS g;

baselineSql: SELECT id, total_cents FROM forger_orders WHERE customer_id = 'c42';
candidateSql: SELECT id, total_cents FROM forger_orders WHERE customer_id = 'c42';
